text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she didn't take first place, Satono 
Diamond was able to focus entirely on 
running her own race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She realizes that both her mind and body 
feel lighter than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was finally able to "overcome" the 
jinx. Freed from the shackles that had 
bound her for so long, Satono Diamond 
sheds tears of relief.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, Kitasan Black arrived and 
proposed a showdown at the Arima Kinen. 
Satono Diamond accepted the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two make a mutual vow to have their 
greatest showdown yet at the Arima Kinen.
